page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance managed via KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs running on x86_64 architecture powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system includes 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a standard 1:4 memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

This instance type provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to support substantial data throughput across cloud infrastructure. It does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data operations. No discrete GPU hardware or specialized accelerator chips are installed on this instance.

With a balanced allocation of compute and system memory, ecs.g5.16xlarge provides high resource density for enterprise workloads. The absence of integrated local disk storage trades local read/write latency for flexible storage provisioning via remote block storage. It fits large-scale general-purpose applications, web server pools, enterprise backend systems, and distributed application processing where balanced vCPU and memory ratios are required.
